items.title: Western Heat Drives August Natural Gas Bidweek Gains as Waha Price More than Doubles
items.summary: Baseload natural gas prices strengthened for August delivery on the first day of bidweek trading, led by gains in the West as forecasts pointed to intensifying heat and new Permian Basin takeaway capacity helped support Waha prices.

items.title: Iran War Risk Keeps US LNG Cargo Values Near Three-Year Highs
items.summary: Global natural gas prices pulled back Monday after surging alongside renewed fighting in Iran, but persistent maritime risk and tight European fundamentals kept US LNG cargo values near their highest level in more than three years.

items.title: Natural Gas Selling Spreads Across Forward Curve as Production Holds Firm
items.summary: August natural gas futures tumbled Monday as resilient production outweighed supportive summer demand, with selling accelerating after prices broke below key technical support.

items.title: Power Burn Retreat Points to Higher Week/Week Lower 48 Natural Gas Storage Injection
items.summary: NGI’s Entropic Analytics flows show a drop in natural gas supply was not quite enough to overcome the decline in gas delivered to power generators last week.

items.title: Even as Mother Nature Brings the Heat, Natural Gas Prices Retreat
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) natural gas futures floundered through midday on Monday as traders weighed robust near-term cooling demand against sturdy supply and Iran War fallout.

items.title: August Natural Gas Futures Test Multiyear Low as Rollover Looms
items.summary: With contract settlement and the end of peak summer fast approaching, natural gas futures were off to a sluggish start on Monday morning.
